# platform.claude.com documentation — Managed Agents

> 27 page(s) of platform.claude.com documentation under Managed Agents. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Managed Agents

- [Core concepts](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/overview.md): Claude Managed Agents is built around four concepts:
- [Core concepts](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/quickstart.md): Managed Agents API requests require the `managed-agents-2026-04-01` beta header, except memory store endpoints, which use `agent-memory-2026-07-22` instead.
- [GitHub MCP and session resources](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/github.md): First, create an agent that declares the GitHub MCP server. The agent definition holds the server URL but no authentication token:
- [Uploading files](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/files.md): First, upload a file using the [Files API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/files):
- [Create a vault](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/vaults.md): Vaults and credentials are workspace-scoped, meaning any API key with workspace access can reference them when creating a session. To revoke access, delete the vault or…
- [How to build an agent](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/onboarding.md): The [visual interface](https://platform.claude.com/workspaces/default/agent-quickstart/) walks you through each field of an agent definition:
- [Create an environment](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/environments.md): Pass the environment ID as a string when [creating a session](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/sessions).
- [Programming languages](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/cloud-sandboxes-reference.md): Cloud sandboxes run as isolated Linux containers on Anthropic-managed infrastructure.
- [Create a rubric](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/define-outcomes.md): A rubric is a markdown document describing per-criterion scoring. The rubric is required.
- [Agent configuration fields](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/agent-setup.md): The following example defines a coding agent that uses Claude Opus 5 with access to the pre-built agent toolset.
- [How it works](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/dreams.md): A **dream** is an asynchronous job that takes:
- [Declare MCP servers on the agent](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/mcp-connector.md): Specify MCP servers in the `mcp_servers` array when creating an agent. Each server needs a `type`, a unique `name`, and a `url`.
- [From a Messages API agent loop](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/migration.md): If you built an agent by calling `messages.create` in a `while` loop, running tool calls yourself, and appending results to the conversation history, most of that code goes away.
- [How it works](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/multiagent-orchestration.md): All agents share the same sandbox, filesystem, and [vault credentials](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/vaults), but each agent runs in its own **session…
- [Permission policy types](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/permission-policies.md): You set permission policies in the agent's `tools` configuration when you create the agent, and you can change them later by [updating the…
- [Event types](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/reference.md): Persisted event type strings follow a `{domain}.{action}` naming convention; the stream-only event deltas (see the Event deltas tab) are the exception.
- [Create a scheduled deployment](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/scheduled-deployments.md): When creating a deployment, you pass the [session configurations](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/sessions) required for execution, in addition to a `schedule`.
- [What you own](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/self-hosted-sandboxes-security.md): Anthropic secures the control plane across all environments: session and work queue integrity, multitenant isolation, and agent-context minimization.
- [How it differs from cloud environments](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/self-hosted-sandboxes.md): Self-hosting controls *where the agent's code executes*.
- [Set a budget at session creation](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/budgets.md): Pass the optional `budget` field when you create the session:
- [Event types](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/events-and-streaming.md): By default, the agent's response text reaches the stream as buffered `agent.message` events, each emitted only after the model request that produced it finishes.
- [Session statuses](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/session-operations.md): Sessions progress through these statuses. See [Start a session](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/sessions) for the session lifecycle.
- [Create a custom skill](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/skills.md): A custom skill is a directory containing a `SKILL.md` file plus any supporting files, uploaded to your workspace as a zip archive or as individual files.
- [Creating a session](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/sessions.md): A session requires an `agent` ID and an `environment` ID. Agents are versioned resources; passing in the `agent` ID as a string creates the session with the latest agent version.
- [Supported event types](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/webhooks.md): Visit **Manage > Webhooks** in the [Claude Console](https://platform.claude.com/settings/workspaces/default/webhooks).
- [Available tools](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/tools.md): The agent toolset includes the following tools. All are enabled by default when you include the toolset in your agent configuration.
- [Overview](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/memory.md): A **memory store** is a workspace-scoped collection of text documents optimized for Claude.
